title: Kratos reports second quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Kratos reported Q2 revenue of USD 458.8 million, adjusted EBITDA of USD 38.2 million, consolidated backlog of USD 2.084 billion, and raised 2026 revenue guidance to USD 1.750-1.810 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies current quarterly results, organic growth, bookings, backlog, program commentary, full-year guidance, investment plans, and free-cash-flow guidance.
